h1: Accessible luxury bathrooms on Wentworth Estate

hero.intro: We install luxury, fit-only bathrooms for homeowners on Wentworth Estate in Virginia Water, Surrey — the private, gated estate built around Wentworth Club and its golf courses, home of the BMW PGA Championship — around 15 to 20 minutes by road from our Bracknell base. An accessible luxury bathroom follows the same fit-only model, built around a level-access shower, a wider doorway and reinforced walls, with every visit to the property coordinated through the estate's access arrangements and any managing agent so the programme runs without delay at the gate.

sections.heading: What makes this service genuinely different from a standard refit
sections.body: An accessible luxury bathroom involves three structural changes a normal bathroom refit doesn't: a shower floor that runs level with the rest of the room, which means moving the waste point rather than simply swapping the tray; a doorway wide enough for comfortable, easy movement, which can mean adjusting the frame or a stud wall; and solid blocking built into any wall that might carry a grab rail or fold-down seat, planned before the wall is boarded and tiled. None of that has to be visible in the finished room. Rails and any reinforced panels are finished in whatever metal tone runs through the rest of the fittings, so the room reads as a high-end bathroom rather than an adapted one.

sections.heading: Access and discretion on a private estate
sections.body: Working on Wentworth Estate means coordinating deliveries, trade access and parking with the estate's security arrangements and your managing agent before the first day on site, not partway through the job. We confirm this at survey stage: vehicle and gate passes, delivery windows for materials and skips, and any restrictions on working hours. For an accessible luxury bathroom project, where strip-out, structural alteration and a full re-tile typically run over multiple weeks, getting that access sorted up front keeps the programme moving rather than losing days to gate delays partway through.

sections.heading: Planning the structural work at survey
sections.body: The £125 survey covers the practical questions specific to this service: the fall available to the existing waste and what moving it for a level threshold involves, which walls are structural versus stud, and where reinforcement should go based on exactly how the room will be used, whether that's beside the shower entry, next to the WC, or along a route between the two. We also use this visit to agree estate access logistics alongside the technical scope, so both are settled before any work starts.

sections.heading: From strip-out to finished room
sections.body: Once scope and access are agreed, we strip the existing bathroom out, carry out the waste re-route and any doorway or wall changes, build in the reinforcement, then first-fix plumbing and electrics ahead of tiling. The sanitaryware, brassware and furniture you've sourced go in last, followed by snagging. As a fit-only service, we're building and finishing the accessible structure to your chosen specification — the products are entirely your decision.

faqs.q: How do you manage access to Wentworth Estate for a multi-week job?
faqs.a: We agree gate passes, delivery windows and any working-hours restrictions with you and your managing agent at survey stage, before work starts, so the programme runs smoothly without delays at the gate partway through.

faqs.q: Will the finished bathroom look like a standard accessible bathroom?
faqs.a: No. Support rails and reinforced areas are finished in the same metal tone as the rest of your fittings, so the room reads as a high-end bathroom rather than a clinical adaptation.

faqs.q: What does an accessible luxury bathroom cost on Wentworth Estate?
faqs.a: Installations start from £3,500, fit-only. The exact figure depends on the extent of structural work and the products you've chosen, confirmed at the £125 survey.

faqs.q: How far is Wentworth Estate from your base?
faqs.a: We're based in Bracknell, around 15 to 20 minutes by road from Wentworth Estate, and we work on the estate regularly.

faqs.q: Do you supply the sanitaryware and rails?
faqs.a: No — this is a fit-only service. You source the sanitaryware, brassware, tiles, furniture and any support rails; we handle strip-out, structural work, first-fix, tiling, plumbing and snagging.
